name: qshell-87261086-blind30-ots
instr:
# qshell: twenty-nine silent behaviour regressions to diagnose and repair without a test suite

I drive a cloud bucket service and a fleet of short-lived isolated environments from this program's command line, and a great deal of what I ask it to do now comes back wrong. Nothing about the services it talks to changed and nothing about the way I invoke it changed. The same commands I have been running for months now print the wrong thing, refuse work they used to accept, or accept work they used to refuse. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to observe from the outside.

Start with what it prints back at me when I ask it to describe something. Invoking it with no arguments, and invoking it with the documentation switch, both used to emit a Markdown page whose first line is a top-level heading naming the program; now neither prints anything usable when there is no more specific topic to show. Human-readable byte counts have traded their two smallest presentations: five hundred and twelve bytes now prints as a fraction of a kilobyte and exactly one kilobyte prints as a raw byte count. A second size presentation, the one reporting in MiB, multiplies where it used to divide, so 512 MiB of data prints as an absurd sixteen-digit MiB figure rather than "512 MiB", and one and a half MiB is equally nonsensical.
